D4Digital

Delay / Reverb

Echo and reverb, also both at once

Digital delay and reverb for audio. The delay repeats the signal after an adjustable time, the reverb simulates a room.

  • Delay time about 1 ms to 2 s
  • Feedback up to about 95 %
  • Time is CV controllable
